description: The bestiary's Point costs are provisional.
testingPriorities: Solo bosses versus representative parties of three or four PCs: focus fire, encounter duration, and independent PC activation economy.
Universal highest-die Charge Impact (particularly when combined with printed Impact 2–4).
Multiple Surges on combined Attack pools.
Extra action economy from bonded companions.
A bird's Cover reduction before pricing it as a universal support feature.
Monster movement/control Commands — especially Stagger — need scenario-level testing against both solo PCs and larger parties.
Compare Young Dragon 445 with a similarly valued PC; Adult Dragon 675, Kraken 700, Elder Treant 475, and Sea Serpent 530 against two, three, and four PCs at different equipment/XP budgets.
